items.name: tokens
items.title: MetalUI tokens
items.description: Soft Hardware colorways (bone, graphite), materials, caps and springs as --mu-* custom properties, and the Tailwind v4 theme built on them. Every component needs it; it installs @unlocalhosted/metalui and imports its tokens.css and theme.css into your global CSS.

items.name: colorway
items.title: MetalUI portal colorway
items.description: Reactive inheritance of an anchor colorway across DOM portals.

items.name: motion
items.title: MetalUI motion
items.description: Springs, swap, indicator, refuse, waiting, awake and haptic helpers that MetalUI components use.

items.name: icons
items.title: MetalUI icon runtime
items.description: The Icon element, the icon catalog and the tick drawing that components such as Checkbox and Toast use.

items.name: cue-document
items.title: MetalUI source text history
items.description: UTF16 source ranges, one gesture per undo entry, and retained selection for editable cues.

items.name: life-icons
items.title: MetalUI life glyph runtime
items.description: Canonical life glyphs, tuned cuts and finite hover acts.

items.name: tick-glyph
items.title: MetalUI selected mark
items.description: The shared tick pen: draw, withdraw and dash-to-tick bend on the generated check route.

items.name: morph-icons
items.title: MetalUI glyph morph runtime
items.description: The MorphIcon element, canonical glyph geometry and shared-settle morph engine for meaning changes.

items.name: icon-components
items.title: MetalUI icon components
items.description: Every product icon as a named React component.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Sections that open in place: row headers with a chevron; the panel grows to its content on the settle spring while the shared chevron morphs from right to down on settle, and leaves on release.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/accordion.md. SwiftUI: MetalAccordion in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: A question that must be answered: the dialog's plate and motion; a click outside shakes it once on the refusal spring instead of closing it, and focus starts on Cancel.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/alert-dialog.md. SwiftUI: MetalAlertDialog in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file someone attached, as a small raised plate: type, name, size or an explicit upload receipt; shared glyphs morph from upload to check only after host confirmation. It lands on the object spring when added, fills while uploading, says when it failed, and leaves on release when removed.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/attachment.md. SwiftUI: MetalAttachment in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person as a small raised disc: initials, or a photo that fades in once loaded; presence as the LED; a group overlaps and spreads apart on the object spring when hovered.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/avatar.md. SwiftUI: MetalAvatar in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: block-silhouette
items.title: Block silhouette
items.description: A block seen from far away: below the far-zoom threshold the canvas draws one flat, cheap shape per block that still says its kind (text bars, a dark code card, a link's tinted glass, a colour, a light file plate, a region's tray and name).
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/block-silhouette.md. SwiftUI: MetalBlockSilhouette in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Where you are, as a path you can climb: levels above in ink2, the current in ink, engraved chevrons between; a new level arrives from the right on the settle spring; long paths fold the middle into a menu.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/breadcrumbs.md. SwiftUI: MetalBreadcrumbs in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: brush-cursor
items.title: Brush cursor
items.description: The pointer while drawing or erasing: a disc in the ink colour at the stroke width times the zoom, or a dashed ring the size of what the eraser removes; it follows the pointer in the same frame.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/brush-cursor.md. SwiftUI: MetalBrushCursor in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A press-in pill button with compact caps, async waiting/result faces and opt-in irreversible hold confirmation. React on Base UI and SwiftUI share recipes and timing.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/button.md. SwiftUI: MetalButton in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: Related action segments cut from one raised bar with engraved seams, independent presses and noninteractive readout windows. SplitButton shares one cap material with a held menu segment.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/button-group.md. SwiftUI: MetalButtonGroup, MetalButtonGroupReadout, MetalButtonGroupToggle, MetalSplitButton in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A calendar for single dates, inclusive ranges and independent dates. Localized segmented date entry, eligibility and form validation share the same selection; date and time can be displayed in an IANA time zone.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/calendar.md. SwiftUI: MetalCalendar, MetalDatePicker in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A person's thing on a raised plate: media, title, a line, actions. A card with a link lifts one grid step on the settle spring as its shadow grows; a card that goes nowhere is still.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/card.md. SwiftUI: MetalCard in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: The dimple checkbox: a recessed well that turns into a dark pressed key with a drawn tick; doing (half green) and ghost (an inferred task's hollow ring) states.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/checkbox.md. SwiftUI: MetalCheckbox in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: Checkbox group
items.description: Several independent choices in a form: row-size checkboxes with labels and an optional parent; ticking the parent ticks its rows in a cascade from the top, clearing clears them at once.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/checkbox-group.md. SwiftUI: MetalCheckboxGroup in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: A small pill with an optional leading LED or glyph and trailing actions: suggestion, glass, glass-action and tag.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/chip.md. SwiftUI: MetalChip in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: code-card
items.title: Code card
items.description: Code as a glass object: numbered, tinted lines (at most 18) on a dark screen under a CODE · LANG · N LINES tag.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/code-card.md. SwiftUI: MetalCodeCard in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: colour-cue
items.title: Colour cue
items.description: A fixed-footprint six-digit colour word opens the shared hue well and rewrites source through one gesture transaction.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/colour-cue.md. SwiftUI: MetalColourCue in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Type to find one of many: a field well that opens the menu's frosted plate; rows filter at once while the plate's height settles to the new count, and the highlight glides row to row.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/combobox.md. SwiftUI: MetalCombobox in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command palette
items.description: ⌘K: a 560 frost plate with a 44 field well, sections of 36 rows with matches marked, a raised selected row with a green bar, destructive rows in red, and a footer of keycaps. Hover moves the selection; ↩ runs, ⇧↩ pins. Built on Base UI Dialog and an inline Combobox.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/command-palette.md. SwiftUI: MetalCommandPalette, MetalCommandPaletteItem in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: connector
items.title: Connector
items.description: The look around ink that joins two blocks: a green halo and end dots on hover (solid attached, hollow free), end handles when selected, and a label chip at the middle; same size on screen at every zoom.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/connector.md. SwiftUI: MetalConnector in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: date-cue
items.title: Date cue
items.description: An inline civil date: day/week detents, nearby relative source words, a resolved date and a Calendar opened by hold or keyboard. Explicit today, bounds and footprint keep date/source semantics stable.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/date-cue.md. SwiftUI: MetalDateCue in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: day
items.title: Day
items.description: The day as an object: a tear-off page with the date in dots, the month, weekday and clock in the pixel face, the minute filling along its foot; the year so far one dot a day, the days left and the moon; one line for the day. Tap the page to tear it off. And a small tile of the date.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/day.md. SwiftUI: MetalDay, MetalDayTile in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal layer: a scrim behind a surface; focus stays inside, Escape and a click outside close it.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/dialog.md. SwiftUI: MetalDialog in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: dot-display
items.title: Dot display
items.description: Square dots on one pitch, printed into a well: each dot one px colour or unlit. A slow display that steps six times a second and never tweens. The picture (a sky, a sticker) is the caller's.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/dot-display.md. SwiftUI: MetalDotDisplay in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: draw-picks
items.title: Draw picks
items.description: The ink and width choices in the drawing group: five glossy ink beads and three width dots in the current ink; the chosen one sits in a sunk well like a latched tool.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/draw-picks.md. SwiftUI: MetalDrawPicks in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: draw-tools
items.title: Draw tools
items.description: The drawing group of the toolbar: eight tool caps (pen, pencil, marker, line, arrow, rectangle, ellipse, eraser) with one latched, then the five inks and three widths.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/draw-tools.md. SwiftUI: MetalDrawTools in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: drop-zone
items.title: Drop zone
items.description: A place that receives files, by drop or by picking: a sunk tray whose edge lights while files are dragged in the window, sinks and says 'Let go to attach' with files over it, refuses a file it won't take with a shake, and comes back up on the object spring when they land.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/drop-zone.md. SwiftUI: MetalDropZone in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: A place with nothing in it yet: an engraved glyph in a well, what would be here, how to start, one action; it rises in on the settle spring when the place empties.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/empty-state.md. SwiftUI: MetalEmptyState in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: enum-cue
items.title: Enum cue
items.description: A finite host-declared source state: cycle, keyboard step, focused wheel or held vertical drag with one source/history transaction and a fixed footprint.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/enum-cue.md. SwiftUI: MetalEnumCue, MetalEnumCueChoice in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: fan
items.title: Fan
items.description: A compact canvas control bar: grouped tools unfold in a three-column grid, contextual glyph actions expand in a tray, and named ink and stroke keys latch the current settings. One cell opens at a time.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/fan.md. SwiftUI: MetalFan in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Text input in a well with a leading glyph and trailing keycaps; SearchField, a button in a well that opens search.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/field.md. SwiftUI: MetalField, MetalSearchField in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter bar
items.description: Names the question a filter asks and switches how the answer is shown: Surface(frost) with a Glyph, the query in Label(query), the count and source engraved, a compact Switcher of views, and IconButton(ghost) pin and close. Formerly LensBar.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/filter-bar.md. SwiftUI: MetalFilterBar in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: folder
items.title: Folder
items.description: A folder on the canvas that holds blocks: a back panel with a tab, up to three blocks peeking up as cards, a frosted flap with its name and count; fans on hover, opens wide when a block is dragged over, swings shut when one lands; six paper colours.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/folder.md. SwiftUI: MetalFolder in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: form-field
items.title: Form field
items.description: A control with its words: label, description and an error that grows open from under the control on the settle spring; invalid and disabled reach every control inside. Fieldset groups fields under a legend.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/form-field.md. SwiftUI: MetalFormField in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: glass-face
items.title: Glass face
items.description: A dark glass object: a bezel around a screen with a glare, a shaded rim and an inner shadow.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/glass-face.md. SwiftUI: MetalGlassFace in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: glyph
items.title: Glyph
items.description: A static icon at a size (10, 14, 16) in an ink (ink, ink2, ink3, inherit); decorative.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/glyph.md. SwiftUI: MetalGlyph in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: hover-engraving
items.title: Hover engraving
items.description: A block's identity on a 420 ms dwell: Surface(tip) beside its first line with the kind and details in Label(engraved), derived tags as Chip(tag) and the recognizer's status with a Led.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/hover-engraving.md. SwiftUI: MetalHoverEngraving in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon button
items.description: A pressable cap with only a glyph: tool (a graphite cap that latches with a green LED), ghost (flat, round) and mini (inside a chip).
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/icon-button.md. SwiftUI: MetalIconButton in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Keycap
items.description: A key's glyph on a small raised cap, in the readout role: 20 tall (16 in a footer), on a light surface, a graphite strip, or sunk into a toast's Undo.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/kbd.md. SwiftUI: MetalKbd in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Text in a set role: engraved, small, title, heading, query, count, cell, value, display, readout, on-graphite and dark; as="input" edits in place.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/label.md. SwiftUI: MetalLabel in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: lasso
items.title: Lasso
items.description: The box a drag on empty canvas draws: a 1 pt intent-green hairline over a faint fill, and a graphite readout under it counting what it will select (● 3 blocks). The same on screen at every zoom.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/lasso.md. SwiftUI: MetalLasso in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: led
items.title: LED
items.description: An 8pt lens in an opaque 1pt socket, beside words. Five shared inks; waiting breathes, failure blinks twice once, off stays dark. Reduced motion holds steady.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/led.md. SwiftUI: MetalLED in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: line-handles
items.title: Line handles
items.description: The presence of a drawn line or arrow: a green halo and end dots on hover, two end handles when selected; the connector's selection language.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/line-handles.md. SwiftUI: MetalLineHandles in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: An inline destination with a persistent engraved underline, directional hover emphasis, press travel, current/unavailable/visited/loading states, and external/download glyphs.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/link.md. SwiftUI: MetalLink in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: link-card
items.title: Link card
items.description: A link as a glass object: the host and path on a screen tinted by the host, a LINK tag and one OPEN action.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/link-card.md. SwiftUI: MetalLinkCard in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: link-cue
items.title: Link cue
items.description: A real URL host-chip link and a separate anchored source field, with an explicit footprint and one confirmed source-history transaction.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/link-cue.md. SwiftUI: MetalLinkCue in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: mark
items.title: Mark
items.description: Inline, metric-neutral text marks: dated and quiet underlines, a tag pill, a derived-tag ring, a hex underline with its swatch, a URL host pill, an inferred pill, the urgency LED and a trailing glyph.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/mark.md. SwiftUI: MetalCueText, MetalCueTag, MetalCueURLPill, MetalCueInferred, MetalCueUrgency, MetalCueLife, Text.metalCue(_:) in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu and correction popover
items.description: A frosted plate of 30 rows (frost-strong at .92, radius 18, padding 6, at least 200 wide) from a trigger or at the pointer: an engraved heading says what it acts on, pointer and keyboard share one highlight, keys at the right, destructive rows red, engraved separators; fades on settle. The correction popover is its right-click form. Built on Base UI Menu and Context Menu.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/menu.md. SwiftUI: MetalMenuPanel, MetalMenuItem, View.metalMenu(isPresented:at:heading:items:) in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: An app's commands under a few words across the top: quiet keys that open the menu's plates; while one is open, a highlight glides between the keys on the settle spring and the next menu opens at once.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/menubar.md. SwiftUI: MetalMenubar in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A level in a range as a row of LED segments coloured by position (green, amber, red); a change sweeps segment by segment from the old edge to the new.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/meter.md. SwiftUI: MetalMeter in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation menu
items.description: A site's sections across the top with panels of links: the plate rises on the surface spring, slides and resizes between keys on the settle spring, and its content moves the way you went.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/navigation-menu.md. SwiftUI: MetalNavigationMenu in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number field
items.description: A number you step, scrub or type: keycaps at each end of a pill well; each step turns the value one drum step (plus up, minus down) and an arrow past a limit shakes only the digits.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/number-field.md. SwiftUI: MetalNumberField in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: numeric-cue
items.title: Numeric cue
items.description: A bounded canonical quantity operated inline: vertical detent scrub, typed spinbutton and horizontal unit conversion. Explicit font footprint and one source transaction per gesture.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/numeric-cue.md. SwiftUI: MetalNumericCue in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Moving through pages of results: page numbers in the switcher's track with previous and next shared-chevron keys; the current page's thumb glides to the chosen page on the part spring.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/pagination.md. SwiftUI: MetalPagination in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: past-banner
items.title: Past banner
items.description: The only chrome that changes while the canvas is scrubbed into the past: Surface(graphite-plain) with the MEMORY engraving, the moment viewed, and a Back to Now cap with its key.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/past-banner.md. SwiftUI: MetalPastBanner in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: perfect-preview
items.title: Perfect preview
items.description: Hold to perfect: while the pen is held still after a rough stroke, the fitted clean shape draws itself round as a faint green outline over 450 ms; when it closes the host morphs the stroke into the shape.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/perfect-preview.md. SwiftUI: MetalPerfectPreview in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: person-cue
items.title: Person cue
items.description: An exact source name opens a host-provided avatar/name picker with a fixed footprint and one confirmed document transaction.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/person-cue.md. SwiftUI: MetalPersonCue, MetalPersonCueChoice in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A small panel that comes out of its trigger: the menu's frosted plate rising one nest from the trigger's side on the surface spring, fading out on release without travelling back.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/popover.md. SwiftUI: MetalPopover in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: preview-card
items.title: Preview card
items.description: What is behind a link, seen by resting on it: after a steady hover the popover's plate rises out of the link with an image, title, description and host; it lingers so you can move onto it.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/preview-card.md. SwiftUI: MetalPreviewCard in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Task amount and explicit idle, running, paused, failed, cancelled and complete states. Bars, slim bars, rings, segmented steps and buffered tracks share one contract; Reset drains on release and values turn on the drum.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/progress.md. SwiftUI: MetalProgress in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: provenance-tooltip
items.title: Provenance tooltip
items.description: One hover away from every cue: a wrapped Tooltip that says where the cue came from (Rule · date parser, Recognizer · 0.82, You), the detail in Tooltip.Dim, with the number whenever the app guessed.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/provenance-tooltip.md. SwiftUI: MetalProvenanceTooltip, .metalProvenance(_:detail:) in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio group
items.description: One choice from a short list: round wells beside their labels; pressing darkens the well, releasing latches a pip in on the part spring while the old choice's pip drops out (the preset-button interlock).
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/radio.md. SwiftUI: MetalRadioGroup in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: region
items.title: Region
items.description: A drawn rectangle with a name that carries a rule: Well(region) with a head (Label name, Label rule, Label count) that lights as a drop target, dims, hides in the past and renames in place; a pinned lens is Surface(lens) with Row(list) rows.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/region.md. SwiftUI: MetalRegion, MetalRegionRow in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: rename-editor
items.title: Rename editor
items.description: A name field and one async rename confirm: basename selection, host validation, pending lock, glyph/drum result and captured-original Undo callback.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/rename-editor.md. SwiftUI: MetalRenameEditor in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: row
items.title: Row
items.description: A list, panel or option row; selection raises its plate, opened detail marks its rail, and completion strikes its text.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/row.md. SwiftUI: MetalRow in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: rule
items.title: Rule
items.description: An engraved groove between groups; graphite on dark chrome.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/rule.md. SwiftUI: MetalRule in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: A region that scrolls with the system's own scrollbar: a slim thumb that fades in while scrolling and widens when reached for, and edge fades that show there is more.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/scroll-area.md. SwiftUI: MetalScrollArea in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: One value from a list of named options: a raised cap showing the value and an up-down chevron, opening the menu's frosted list with the chosen row over the trigger; the chosen row carries the latched green LED.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/select.md. SwiftUI: MetalSelect in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: selection-frame
items.title: Selection frame
items.description: The one selection for every kind of object: a 1.25 green ring with a flat collar at offset 6, eight handles on the ring line, and a graphite readout of the measured frame. Hover shows only faint corner dots and an edge light.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/selection-frame.md. SwiftUI: MetalSelectionFrame in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: settings
items.title: Settings
items.description: An app's settings as sections of rows: an engraved heading over a raised card; each row a name, an optional detail and one control on the right; engraved rules between rows; shortcut rows with keycaps.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/settings.md. SwiftUI: MetalSettings in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge (right or bottom) on the surface spring, follows a drag one to one, and leaves on release, sooner for a harder flick.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/sheet.md. SwiftUI: MetalSheet in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: An app's side place for moving between places: sections of items with one highlight that glides to the current place; it collapses to a rail (words first, then width) with tooltips.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/sidebar.md. SwiftUI: MetalSidebar in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: size-readout
items.title: Size readout
items.description: A graphite pill that reads a measured value: an object's size, a multi-selection's count, a copy, a zoom level. Surface(graphite-deep) with a live Led and the value in Label(readout).
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/size-readout.md. SwiftUI: MetalSizeReadout in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Where content will be before it arrives: blocks, lines and circles in the well's sunk look, shown after a beat with a soft sheen, swapped for the content on the settle spring.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/skeleton.md. SwiftUI: MetalSkeleton in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Scalar or range amounts on a clamped track: horizontal/vertical, centred or neutral fill, named independent knobs, step detents, transient value bubble, drum readout and volume/brightness glyphs. Base UI preserves keyboard and form behavior.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/slider.md. SwiftUI: MetalSlider in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: snap-guides
items.title: Snap guides
items.description: The lines that explain a snap while a person moves or resizes on the canvas: 1 pt intent green, solid for aligned edges, dashed for aligned centres, spanning the aligned objects plus 8 pt, the same on screen at every zoom.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/snap-guides.md. SwiftUI: MetalSnapGuides in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A small series plot: a line with gaps, dots, the last point emphasised, a dashed baseline at the average.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/sparkline.md. SwiftUI: MetalSparkline in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: spatial-field
items.title: Spatial field
items.description: One quiet, content-aware dot field for a Place. It yields to object footprints and reinforces the host-selected Region while the host retains placement authority.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/spatial-field.md. SwiftUI: MetalSpatialFieldView in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Unknown work in a host glyph slot: current ink, delayed arrival and minimum visibility. Large hosts show their incoming shape; known amounts use Progress.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/spinner.md. SwiftUI: MetalSpinner in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: split-pane
items.title: Split pane
items.description: Two places with a divider you can move: dragged one to one, it snaps to the default size or shut on the part spring; keys step it on settle.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/split-pane.md. SwiftUI: MetalSplitPane in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: status
items.title: Status badge
items.description: A readable 26pt status plate with words and a sunk LED or retained morphing meaning glyph. Quiet, opaque strong tint, explicit transparent/frosted surfaces and a solid override. State gestures have reduced-motion alternatives.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/status.md. SwiftUI: MetalStatusBadge in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: suggestion-chip
items.title: Suggestion chip
items.description: One question the recognizer asks at middle confidence, beside its block: Chip(suggestion) with the question, its confidence as a small engraving, and mini accept and dismiss buttons. Faint until the block is hovered.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/suggestion-chip.md. SwiftUI: MetalSuggestionChip in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: surface
items.title: Surface
items.description: A raised plate or card from a material recipe: raise, raise-lite, raise-sm, frost, plate, panel, pop, tip, lens and the graphites.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/surface.md. SwiftUI: MetalSurface in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A setting that is on or off and takes effect at once: a sunk pill track with a raised thumb that slides on the part spring; on, the track fills soft green.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/switch.md. SwiftUI: MetalSwitch in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: switcher
items.title: Switcher
items.description: A pill of pills on Base UI RadioGroup: a well track, options on the height ladder, and a raised thumb that glides to the selection on the part spring.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/switcher.md. SwiftUI: MetalSwitcher in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows of things, read across and compared down: engraved labels and hairlines; sorting turns the column's arrow and every row travels to its new place on the settle spring; rows select with the checkbox.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/table.md. SwiftUI: MetalTable in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches which panel is shown: the switcher track and gliding thumb as the tab list, and panels that drift in from the side the thumb went.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/tabs.md. SwiftUI: MetalTabs in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: tag-cue
items.title: Tag cue
items.description: Recent source tags cycle with canonical identity colour; a shared autocomplete chooses tags for a captured unfinished hash range.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/tag-cue.md. SwiftUI: MetalTagCue, MetalTagCuePicker in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Several lines of text in the field well that grows with what is written on the settle spring; with a limit, a counter fades in near it and shakes on the refusal spring when writing goes past it.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/textarea.md. SwiftUI: MetalTextarea in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: time-scrubber
items.title: Time scrubber
items.description: Time as a dimension of the surface: a Slider (track, moment marks, day ticks, knurled knob) under an engraved readout with NOW as Button(link) while in the past. Formerly MemoryScrubber.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/time-scrubber.md. SwiftUI: MetalTimeScrubber in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: The result of a person's own action, with Undo: a 44 tall smoked pill at the bottom centre. Results stack as a deck in depth, newest in front; pointing fans it out, a swipe dismisses, a repeat counts. Built on Base UI Toast. Retained updates and promise results morph their authored glyph and label in place, preserving card identity and dismissal.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/toast.md. SwiftUI: MetalToastDeck, .metalToastDeck(_:), MetalToast, .metalToast(_:) in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A latching push button: the button cap with a lamp; pressing sinks it past the catch, releasing into on settles it at the latch on the part spring with the lamp lit. Toggle group puts the keys in a row.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/toggle.md. SwiftUI: MetalToggle in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: tool-strip
items.title: Tool strip
items.description: Selection-aware graphite action strip: stable verb intersections, glyph keys and count, anchored collision placement, More overflow, disabled reasons, waiting feedback and held irreversible actions.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/tool-strip.md. SwiftUI: MetalToolStrip in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar and tool button
items.description: A frosted capsule strip of circular 36 tool caps (frost in the colorway, or graphite), latched tools pressed with a green LED, engraved separators, a search well, and tooltips with the key. Built on Base UI Toolbar, Toggle and Tooltip.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/toolbar.md. SwiftUI: MetalToolbar, MetalToolButton, MetalToolbarSeparator in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Names an icon-only control and its key: a graphite pill chip in the label role, SELECT · V with the key dimmed, 10 from the trigger after 120 ms, grouped so the next trigger shows at once; flips near the edge; fades on settle. Built on Base UI Tooltip. wrap makes a longer note that wraps at 280 with its detail in Tooltip.Dim.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/tooltip.md. SwiftUI: View.metalTooltip(_:shortcut:edge:) in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: weather
items.title: Weather
items.description: Weather as an object: a slab with a dot-matrix sky sunk into it that follows the time of day, the temperature in the pixel face on its ground, the next hours and the week as dot ranges on one scale; and a small tile of one sky.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/weather.md. SwiftUI: MetalWeather, MetalWeatherTile in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: well
items.title: Well
items.description: A sunk field or track: field, track, region (with a drop-target state) and graphite.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/well.md. SwiftUI: MetalWell in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: block-ai-composer
items.title: AI composer
items.description: A chat block: a composer that grows, attachments, a model choice, and replies that stream in word by word with stop, copy and retry.
items.docs: Docs: https://metalui.dev/blocks/ai-composer. Import it from components/metalui/screens/ai-composer/ai-composer. Needs @unlocalhosted/metalui@^0.4.0.

items.name: block-availability-picker
items.title: Availability picker
items.description: A booking block: a host, a call length, a calendar of the next six weeks, the day's free times re-labelled by time zone, and Confirm to Booked.
items.docs: Docs: https://metalui.dev/blocks/availability-picker. Import it from components/metalui/screens/availability-picker/availability-picker. Needs @unlocalhosted/metalui@^0.4.0.

items.name: block-settings
items.title: Settings
items.description: A settings block: profile fields validated on blur and save, notification switches, a colorway and density, and a save bar that counts unsaved changes.
items.docs: Docs: https://metalui.dev/blocks/settings. Import it from components/metalui/screens/settings/settings. Needs @unlocalhosted/metalui@^0.4.0.

items.name: block-share-panel
items.title: Share panel
items.description: A sharing block: drop files that upload with progress, invite people by email with a permission, and turn on and copy a share link.
items.docs: Docs: https://metalui.dev/blocks/share-panel. Import it from components/metalui/screens/share-panel/share-panel. Needs @unlocalhosted/metalui@^0.4.0.

items.name: block-studio-week
items.title: Studio week
items.description: One week of a canvas workspace on a dot matrix, hour by hour, with readouts for notes, regions, confirmed cues and time in the past, and the recognizer by kind.
items.docs: Docs: https://metalui.dev/blocks/studio-week. Import it from components/metalui/screens/studio-week/studio-week. Needs @unlocalhosted/metalui@^0.4.0.

items.name: block-task-inbox
items.title: Task inbox
items.description: A task list block: search and views, a tick that settles a task into Done, multi-select with a tool strip to complete, assign, snooze or delete, and Undo.
items.docs: Docs: https://metalui.dev/blocks/task-inbox. Import it from components/metalui/screens/task-inbox/task-inbox. Needs @unlocalhosted/metalui@^0.4.0.
